### 📝 PYQ Contribution Checklist

Before submitting your Pull Request, verify each requirement:

- [ ] The paper belongs strictly to **MIT Manipal 3rd Semester Endsem** examinations.
- [ ] Correct subject is selected (Data Structures, Discrete Math, DSCO, DCCN, or Data Analytics).
- [ ] Examination year is correct (e.g. 2025, 2024, 2023, 2022).
- [ ] Paper variant is correctly identified (Regular or Makeup).
- [ ] The actual PDF file is included under `public/pyqs/semester-3/endsem/<subject-id>/<year>/`.
- [ ] Archive metadata in `src/data/archiveData.ts` has been updated with valid title, code, and topics.
- [ ] PDF opens correctly, is fully legible, and contains no private advertisements or watermarks.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes with 0 errors.
- [ ] No unrelated files, node_modules, or secret files are included.
